title: Support of the current obtained by integrating over a ball
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be any measure on ℝ^P and ξ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) any function. Let x ∈ ℝ^P and ρ ∈ ℝ, and let A ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n) satisfy A(ω) = ∫_{B_ρ(x)} ξ(y)(ω(y)) dμ(y) for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟^n(ℝ^P), where B_ρ(x) is the open ball. Then spt A ⊆ B̄_ρ(x), the closed ball (spt is GeometricCurrentOn.support).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (A : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (x : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, A ω = ∫ y in ball x ρ, ξ y ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y) ∂μ) → A.support ⊆ closedBall x ρ
